CA = 3 × 5 = 15, DE = 18, EF = 3× 5 + 9 = 24 and FD =  6 × 5 = 30
Hence, AB = 9 cm,  BC = 12 cm, CA = 15 cm,
DE = 18 cm, EF = 24 cm and FD = 30 cm.
